verdict.rationale: Sunbiz's public homepage offers a feature to "find out where we are in processing your documents." Its records can be searched by name, and online-filed reports are posted immediately with a free downloadable image once processed, so a founder can check filing status from public pages. Evidence for each of these is only a one-line mention. Missing for 10: details on how the status lookup works (e.g. by document or tracking number) and what it shows, explicit coverage of applications and cases beyond document filings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
